mapper.sql: select c.consultation_id, c.patient_id, c.doctor_id, c.room_name, c.status, c.title, c.description, c.start_time, c.end_time, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, c.del_flag, p1.nick_name as patient_name, p2.nick_name as doctor_name from t_consultation c left join sys_user p1 on c.patient_id = p1.user_id left join sys_user p2 on c.doctor_id = p2.user_id
mapper.insert: insert into t_consultation ( patient_id, doctor_id, room_name, status, title, description, create_by, create_time, remark, del_flag ) values ( #{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{roomName}, #{status}, #{title}, #{description}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark}, '0' )
mapper.update: update t_consultation set del_flag = '1' where consultation_id = #{consultationId}
